failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_adjustment_list with the invoice_id to find the adjustment id.
failure_modes.when: id does not name a live adjustment in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: The reversal is parked for the account owner to approve in the Simpler UI.
failure_modes.when: an agent actor attempts the reversal (retiring money facts is human-approved)

preconditions: Adjustments are append-only — a wrong adjustment is retired (approval required), never edited. Re-record the correct one with invoice_adjustment_record.
Retiring an adjustment restores the invoice's remaining balance immediately — remaining_cents derives from live rows.

description: [REQUIRES APPROVAL] Retires a dilution fact row — the only correction lane (adjustments are append-only; amounts are never edited). If the retired row was a credit that settled the invoice, the status rolls from 'paid' back to 'sent' and paid_at clears; the remaining balance and the derived 'written_off' state re-derive from the live rows immediately. An agent's call parks here for human approval. NEXT: invoice_adjustment_record to re-record the correct amount.
name: invoice_adjustment_delete
